notes.text:
TEST 1 - UNARY BYPASS
Select Gaussian Blur. PASS: Bypass node is checked, the card is visibly faded with its Bypassed badge, dotted outline, and pass-through cue, and its scientific output is the exact Image Source value and metadata. The card thumbnail remains a presentation-only preview of the sigma 2.4 blur that Run would produce; it never becomes downstream scientific data.

TEST 2 - MULTI-INPUT RL-TV BYPASS
Select Richardson-Lucy TV. Both Image and PSF are connected, and Bypass node starts checked. PASS: the internal cue runs from Image (port 0) to the sole output. The exact Image/intensity input is forwarded scientifically; PSF stays connected but is ignored by the bypass path. The would-run thumbnail is presentation only and may use the PSF plus the stored three-iteration settings. Clear Bypass node to run RL-TV, then check it again to restore the exact Image pass-through.

TEST 3 - TERMINALS AND BOUNDARIES
Select the Image Source and the rightmost, terminal Gaussian Blur node. PASS: a source never offers Bypass, while a terminal node has no enabled bypass because there is no scientific output consumer. Split Channels and other multi-output operations cannot define one unambiguous pass-through output. Save Image and Batch Output are publication boundaries and are also excluded.

TEST 4 - TYPE-INCOMPATIBLE SPLICE
Select Otsu Threshold. Its image input normally becomes a mask consumed by Remove Outliers. PASS: Bypass is unavailable and its tooltip explains that forwarding image data cannot satisfy the mask input. VIPP fails closed instead of relabelling the image as a mask. This check is topology-aware: only a primary input that every current output consumer accepts can be forwarded.

TEST 5 - ONE SHARED CONTRACT
Toggle either eligible node, then use Undo/Redo and save/reopen if desired. PASS: the checkbox, context-menu action, card treatment, exact primary-input alias, scientific history, export, GPU-neutral Bypassed status, and batch Run/Bypass profile all agree. Secondary inputs remain authored so returning to Run needs no rewiring.
